title: Our history
slide_intent: Ground an institutional origin story in people and a specific action so readers can understand how a movement began.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can connect the scale of its later work to Eunice Kennedy Shriver’s early response to barriers to participation.
demonstration: A full-page black-and-white photograph shows an activity in progress. Three columns over the lower part of the image connect the early exclusion, a day camp and the movement’s later growth.
practical_value: Frame a history account by pairing a specific early scene with the decision that changed what people could do.

content_islands.name: Historical photograph
content_islands.spec: Use the photograph as a full-page ground and place the section and page headings in white at the top.

content_islands.name: Chronological account
content_islands.spec: Lay a dark translucent band over the lower-right region. Use three short columns, emphasizing the final statement in bold.
